programme.title: Grosses galères et gâteaux gras
programme.desc: Sam n'a pas fait de bêtise depuis 10 jours. En récompense, ses amis lui offrent une visite guidée d'une fabrique de gâteaux gras canadiens, ses pâtisseries préférées.

programme.title: Plein les yeux
programme.desc: Freddie est frustré de n'être qu'un technicien. Il rêve de participer à l'aspect artistique de l'émission. Carly devant s'absenter pour le week-end, Sam accepte à contrecoeur de le laisser présenter iCarly avec elle.

programme.title: Christopher Cane présente
programme.desc: Christopher Cane (l'acteur anglais qui joue le rôle de Rex dans Victorious) reçoit l'équipe d'iCarly dans son émission.

programme.title: Lépidémie One Direction
programme.desc: Carly attrape une maladie contagieuse et contamine un membre des One Direction accidentellement.

programme.title: Le restaurant
programme.desc: Avec l'aide de Sam, Gibby ouvre un restaurant secret dans le sous-sol de l'école.

programme.title: Poisson davril
programme.desc: Carly et Spencer évoquent les événements du passé, alors qu'ils sont sur le point d'être renvoyés le jour du Poisson d'avril.

programme.title: Pear Store
programme.desc: Freddie obtient un emploi dans un magasin Pear, mais Sam obtient le même poste.

programme.title: Demilloween
programme.desc: iCarly célèbre Demilloween, un nouvel événement inventé par Carly quand elle annonce la tenue d'une fête!

programme.title: Chip la terreur
programme.desc: Spencer se bat contre le frère de Chuck, Chip.

programme.title: Banni
programme.desc: Les intrusions intempestives de Ti-bo dans l'appartement de Spencer et de Carly agacent cette dernière au point qu'elle lui en interdit l'accès. Le voilà banni des lieux ! Pour se venger, il en fait de même avec Carly et la bannit du Smoothie Groovy.

programme.title: Jai perdu ma tête à Vegas
programme.desc: La mère de Sam a été arrêtée à Las Vegas. Sam va devoir trouver deux mille cinq cent dollars pour payer la caution. Toute l'équipe part donc pour Vegas.

programme.title: Sauvez Carly
programme.desc: Sam retrouve Dana, une amie qui vient de sortir de prison. Elle présente Carly à cette amie, qui l'invite à une fête. Carly se rend à cette fête, mais les relations avec Dana restent difficiles du fait de leur caractère.

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: LAmérique sous le choc
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon est fan d'icarly... Ils les invitent dans son émission télévisée... Quelle chance ! Oui... mais pas de chance ! Gibby perd son pantalon devant le monde entier ! Et ça coûte cher.... 500 000 dollars ! Heureusement que Jimmy est là !

programme.title: Des amis pour Spencer
programme.desc: En faisant la liste des invités pour l'anniversaire de Spencer, Carly et ses amis se rendent compte qu'il n'a pas d'amis de son âge. Ils se donnent alors pour mission de lui en trouver.

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les filles s'apprêtent à profiter de leur mini-station balnéaire au bord du lac. Mais voilà que débarque Marla Maraschino, avide de faire un reportage sur les vacances des stars. Cerisette et ses amies se donnent un mal fou pour l'éviter. Et...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Baba Hortensia lit une histoire de sa création aux bébés Petits-Pépins. Celle d'un hiver très peu rigoureux, où la neige fond trop vite et les habitants de Fraisi-Paradis sont bien tristes. Lili Framboise craint de ne pas vendre ses...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: La tempête souffle sur Fraisi-Paradis et les facteurs renoncent à distribuer le courrier. Ce qui n'arrange pas Baba Hortensia, pressée de lire le dernier roman de Patty Persimmone. Elle invente des " patins volants ", des patins à glace...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: C'est le printemps et nos amis de Fraisi-Paradis multiplient les projets. Lili Framboise veut organiser un défilé de mode de sa collection printemps/été. Petit Pépin Mécano, lui, met au point un spectacle de jets d'eau : la Fontaine...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Le printemps est revenu et les filles répètent une nouvelle chanson. Cerisette leur annonce qu'on les attend pour un concert à Mégapomme. Elles sont toutes sont folles de joie à l'idée de partir en tournée, sauf Fleur d'Oranger, très...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon du nom de Coco Berry arrive à Fraisi-Paradis, accompagné d'une ribambelle de chiens. Aucun d'entre eux n'a de maître et Coco Berry cherche à les faire adopter. Il fait rapidement la connaissance de Charlotte et de toutes ses...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Tous les deux fans des livres de la célèbre détective Patty Persimmone, Baba Hortensia et Coco Berry décident d'écrire ensemble leur propre roman policier. Mais Baba Hortensia a des idées bien arrêtées et ne prend pas en compte les...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.sub-title: Le mystérieux mystère du concours canin
programme.desc: Baba Hortensia et Coco Berry reçoivent une mauvaise nouvelle. Leur roman policier a été rejeté par le Fraisi-Mystère Magazine. Loin de les décourager, cette nouvelle les pousse à redoubler d'efforts. Ils décident d'écrire un nouveau roman...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Prunetille veut monter une pièce de théâtre pour les bébés Petits-Pépins. Mais elle se prend au jeu et veut égaler les productions de Mégapomme. La pièce est un échec total, tout va de travers. Prunetille promet de monter un projet moins...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les filles décident de monter la pièce " Fraisillon et le prince fraisi-charmant " pour les bébés Petits-Pépins. Elles forcent la main à Coco Berry pour qu'il accepte le rôle masculin. Celui-ci accepte à contre-cœur et les problèmes...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Il était une fois, dans un pays fruité, un roi et une reine d'une grande sagesse. Ils avaient trois filles et devaient décider à laquelle des princesses confier le royaume en leur absence. Pour les départager, ils leur demandèrent de trouver...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: C'est la panique à Fraisi-Paradis. La source de poudre de Petit Pépin tombe en panne et plus personne n'a de jus. Les Petits-Pépins entreprennent de gros travaux qui font beaucoup de bruit. Charlotte et ses amies sont obligées de quitter la...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les travaux entrepris par les Petits-Pépins pour réparer la source de poudre de Petit Pépin ont pris du retard. Le vacarme est assourdissant. Encore une fois Charlotte et ses amies vont être obligées de quitter la ville et de trouver une...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les Petits-Pépins n'ont toujours pas trouvé la source de la panne de courant qui paralyse Fraisi-Paradis depuis plusieurs épisodes. Les travaux continuent donc. Charlotte et ses amies se préparent à passer la nuit sous une tente. Mais Mimi...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les chiens sèment la pagaille à Fraisi-Paradis et les filles décident de leur construire un parc de jeux. Elles font appel à Coco Berry. Mais celui-ci est très maladroit et n'est pas du tout bricoleur. Jusqu'au jour où il trouve un...

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Le jour de l'ouverture du parc pour chiens est arrivé. Tout est prêt, mais les chiens refusent d'entrer. Les amies avancent différentes hypothèses et tentent diverses approches, sans succès. En fait, les chiens sont effrayés par un chapeau...

programme.title: American Kickboxer 1
programme.desc: Un champion de kickboxing est emprisonné pour un meurtre accidentel grâce au témoignage de son ennemi. À sa libération, il affronte son ennemi dans un combat où tout le monde est gagnant.

programme.title: Alliés
programme.desc: Août 1944. Une équipe de soldats Britanniques dirigée par un Capitaine Américain est envoyée en France derrière les lignes ennemies pour une mission qui pourrait mettre fin à la guerre. Mais rien ne se passe comme prévu. Le Sergent Harry McBrain et le Capitaine Gabriel Jackson comprennent qu'ils doivent mettre de côtés leur rivalité personnelle pour mener à bien leur mission.

programme.title: Pterodactyl
programme.desc: Un volcan endormi au cœur de la forêt turque renferme un secret mortel. Parfaitement conservés, des oeufs de ptérodactyle sont prêts à éclore...

programme.title: Le Requin Mutant
programme.desc: Les invités d'un mariage sur une île doivent faire face à un requin à six têtes qui attaque l'île.

programme.title: Far away: les soldats de l'espoir
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Jun Shik travaille à la ferme du grand-père de Tatsuo alors que la Corée est colonisée par le Japon, mais il rêve de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Tokyo en tant que coureur de marathon. Tatsuo vise également à devenir marathonien, ce qui crée une rivalité entre eux. Mais la guerre éclate et ils sont tous deux forcés de s'enrôler dans l'armée. Tatsuo devient chef de la défense dans l'unité de Jun Shik et élabore un plan qui échoue. Jun Shik et Tatsuo sont capturés par les Soviétiques. Ils s'échappent mais sont rapidement capturés par les Allemands et forcés de se séparer. En 1944, ils se retrouvent sur les plages de Normandie.

programme.title: Christmas do over
programme.desc: Se sentant obligé de passer Noël chez son ex-femme, son jeune fils et ses anciens beaux-parents, un auteur de jingles sans grande envergure se retrouve à vivre le jour de Noël encore et encore. Avant de pouvoir reprendre le cours de sa vie, il devra déterminer ce qui doit changer dans sa vie.

programme.title: La Sorcière De Noël
programme.desc: "Paola a une double identité : le jour, elle est maîtresse d'école, et la nuit, elle se transforme en gentille sorcière et distribue des cadeaux de Noël aux enfants qui ont été sages pendant l'année."

programme.title: L'aventure Magique de Noël
programme.desc: La veille de Noël, la famille Nolan se retrouve transportée au Pôle Nord, où le Père Noël leur annonce qu'il a besoin de leur aide pour sauver Noël!

programme.title: If You Believe
programme.desc: Une rédactrice en chef blasée a presque abandonné sa quête du bonheur, jusqu'à ce qu'elle se cogne la tête et reçoive la visite de son soi plus jeune (Hayden Panettiere). À présent, la joyeuse et insouciante fille de sept ans aide Susan, une adulte, à redécouvrir son enfant intérieur.

programme.title: L'Amour au pied du sapin
programme.desc: Le plan était facile, le travail ne l'était pas. Par une nuit enneigée, une équipe serrée de quatre criminels planifie un vol de routine. Lorsque les choses tournent mal, l'amitié, la loyauté et la confiance sont poussées à leur paroxysme.

programme.title: Justice Armée
programme.desc: Lorsqu'il apprend que son frère a été assassiné pendant son service militaire, Webster se met à la recherche des auteurs du meurtre. Il découvre alors une conspiration qui remonte jusqu'au gouvernement américain.

programme.title: Cartel Escape
programme.desc: Carla, une jeune mexicaine, se retrouve par accident aux États-Unis après avoir traversé un tunnel abandonné. Au cœur du désert de Yucca Valley, elle se retrouve alors prise dans un jeu mortel du chat et de la souris entre la CIA, le cartel et des informateurs du gouvernement.

programme.title: Italian Race
programme.desc: Giulia est une championne de course en puissance qui voit sa vie basculer lorsque son père décède. Mineure, elle ne peut compter que sur son frère qu'elle n'a pas vu depuis dix ans et qui est toxicomane. Ensemble, ils vont essayer de remonter la pente grâce à leur passion commune : la course automobile.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Après avoir planifié le casse "parfait", Nick Mullins est trahi et laissé pour mort par ses partenaires. Il survit et décide de se tourner vers les personnes qu'il a essayé de voler pour l'aider à se venger.

programme.title: On the road...
programme.desc: « On the road to paradise » raconte la rencontre improbable dans un restoroute d'une serveuse au bord de la crise de nerfs, d'un camionneur collectionneur de routiers et d'une jeune femme en pleine rupture amoureuse. Tous les trois partagent sans le savoir, le même secret : ils viennent d'assassiner un homme. Un policier entre alors dans le restaurant...

programme.title: Flesh
programme.desc: L'Empire dévoile tout mais ne voit rien. Ses ennemis idéalisent tout mais ne tolèrent rien. L'orgasme terrestre des putains cathodiques pour les uns. L'orgasme éternel des 70 vierges paradisiaques pour les autres. Et si la chair était seule au monde ?

programme.title: La révolution des crabes
programme.desc: Les crabes de l'estuaire de la Gironde ont un sérieux handicap : ils ne peuvent pas changer de direction et sont condamnés à marcher toute leur vie suivant la même ligne droite. Comment vivent-ils ce tragique destin ?

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Ena, femme pompière passionnée, est très investie dans son métier. Sa fascination pour le feu l'épanouie autant qu'elle impacte sur sa vie familiale.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Fugue
programme.desc: Un petit bonhomme tout à fait quelconque veut prendre soin d'une jeune pousse en la mettant au soleil. Dans un filet, il capture un nuage pour pouvoir abreuver la plante, mais celui-ci, se transformant en eau, glisse au travers des mailles. Le petit bonhomme tentera par tous les moyens de rattraper ce filet d'eau indispensable au bien-être de sa plante.

programme.title: Je suis marié
programme.desc: Un pavillon de banlieue. Une Porsche. Des bigoudis. Une cacahuète...

programme.title: Belle gueule
programme.desc: C'est l'été, le sud. Tous les jours, Sarah, seize ans, vend des beignets sur les plages avec son père. Un soir, elle fait la rencontre de Baptiste...

programme.title: Héros
programme.desc: Maxime a 14 ans. Il vit dans un petit village. Adolescent à la carrure ingrate, il peine à trouver grâce aux yeux d'Astrid, la jeune fille de 15 ans dont il est amoureux. Un matin, le village se réveille avec un immense graffiti sur le mur de l'école primaire. Si l'on ignore qui en est l'auteur, on sait tout de même quelle en est la cause : le maire sortant, unique candidat à sa succession, a enrôlé dans sa liste un militant local du front national. Les autorités ouvrent l'enquête tandis que les jeunes cherchent à connaître l'identité de leur héros. maxime voit là une belle occasion d'attirer l'attention d'Astrid.

programme.title: Tout le monde dit je t'aime
programme.desc: Marion quatorze ans, vient de recevoir un mot d'amour de son copain. Elle demande l'avis de sa meilleure amie, Joséphine. Les deux jeunes filles ne sont pas d'accord quant à l'interprétation du mot “Je t‘aime”.

programme.title: Goût bacon
programme.desc: À la suite d'une rumeur lancée à cause de la diffusion d'un snapchat au contenu ambigu, deux amis, Bilal et Adil, se mettent en quête de filles pour sauver leur réputation. Mais le chemin est loin d'être celui qu'ils avaient imaginé…

programme.title: Nocturnes
programme.desc: Tes est en train de sortir de l'anorexie. La remontée à la surface est difficile, le corps est déréglé, ne répond plus de la même manière. Remanger, c'est accepter de lâcher prise, de perdre le contrôle. C'est à la fois reprendre des forces et accepter sa vulnérabilité. Mais le jeu en vaut la chandelle.

programme.title: Petit crabe
programme.desc: Jeanne vit au bord de la mer. Elle est jeune mais amère. Elle travaille à la poissonnerie parce qu'il faut bien...par dépit surement. Elvis à sa vie, son bateau. Ça lui suffit. De temps en temps, peut être plus maintenant que Kevin, son meilleur pote, est parti étudier à Lyon, il va voir Jeanne. Elle l'intrigue, le perturbe. Perturbe son monde...

programme.title: Les enfants de la nuit
programme.desc: Printemps 1944, dans un village reculé. Henriette, 20 ans, vit seule avec son grand-père Charles. Sa mère a rejoint le maquis. Henriette vit une histoire d'amour avec Josef, un jeune soldat allemand.

programme.title: Bourgeons
programme.desc: Chaque matin, c'est le rituel : Camille, une dame de quatre-vingts printemps sort de chez elle en trimbalant deux gros arrosoirs pour s'occuper de son jardin de l'autre côté de la rue.

programme.title: Petit astre
programme.desc: Alexis, 9 ans, va prendre le train tout seul pour la première fois. Au même moment, à des milliers de kilomètres, une sonde spatiale s'apprête à se réveiller.

programme.title: Rideau
programme.desc: Tom, comédien, vient de se faire quitter par son amie Angela, comédienne dans la même troupe que lui.Encore très amoureux, il tente de la reconquérir.

programme.title: Le Vent tourne
programme.desc: Un weekend d'été à la campagne. Une toute jeune fille s'éloigne de sa famille et se baigne nue dans la rivière. Elle pose ses vêtements sur une grosse pierre bienveillante. Lorsqu'elle ressort de l'eau, ils ont disparu.

programme.title: Les difficultés de la plaine
programme.desc: Marlène et Bachir travaillent en intérim dans un autodrome. Marlène a commis une petite faute dénoncée par un collègue, elle est mise à pied.

programme.title: Jamais Jamais
programme.desc: Week-end de Pâques, dans une ville de province. De permanence au commissariat, les lieutenants Françoise Ruiz et Clémentine Arpinon règlent les affaires courantes. L'ennui, de circonstance, éveille chez ces deux femmes que tout oppose une certaine envie d'en découdre. Une intervention pour tapage nocturne leur offre l'occasion de passer à l'acte.

programme.title: Fille du calvaire
programme.desc: Jérôme est tombé amoureux d'une jeune femme qu'il essaie de séduire. Jour après jour, il raconte l'évolution des opérations à son ami Patrick qui dispense ses conseils et vit par procuration les aventures de son cadet.

programme.title: Point De Chute
programme.desc: Trois voyous enlèvent une jeune fille de quinze ans, Patricia, pour obtenir de son père le versement d'une rançon. Ils la séquestrent dans une cabane perdue au bord de la mer et la battent. Seul Eddie, un jeune voyou, gardien de la jeune fille, s'insurge contre ces méthodes. A travers un fait divers tragique, le portrait de deux adolescents dans un climat d'angoisse et de violence.

programme.title: Phantom Town
programme.desc: Quand un garçon de 16 ans et ses 2 jeunes frères et soeurs partent à la recherche de leurs parents disparus, leur quête les conduit dans une ville fantôme au milieu du désert. Ils découvrent rapidement que ce n'est pas un endroit touristique ordinaire...

programme.title: Boychoir
programme.desc: Un garçon de onze ans très perturbé, élève de l'American Boychoir School, fait la rencontre d'un chef de chœur qui va permettre à son talent d'éclore.

programme.title: Gandahar
programme.desc: Gandahar, paisible oasis au cour d'une galaxie agitée, est menacée par une force terrible et mystérieuse.

programme.title: Black sea
programme.desc: Récemment renvoyé par sa société, un capitaine de sous-marin est embauché pour trouver un trésor gisant au fond de la mer.

programme.title: USS Indianapolis
programme.desc: Juillet 1945. Le navire américain USS INDIANAPOLIS, commandé par le capitaine McVay (Nicolas Cage), est en mission secrète. Parti livrer des composants de la bombe atomique larguée sur Hiroshima, il est torpillé à son retour par les japonais et sombre dans l'Océan Pacifique.

programme.title: Pas un mot
programme.desc: Le psychiatre Nathan Conrad mène une vie paisible. Quand sa fille est kidnappée, il doit débloquer un code enfoui dans l'esprit dérangé de sa nouvelle patiente.

programme.title: Qui a tué Maggie Moore(s)?
programme.desc: Le chef de police Sanders enquête sur les meurtres étranges de deux femmes portant le même nom et démêle un réseau de mensonges dans une petite ville.

programme.title: Seule Contre Tous
programme.desc: Kathryn Bolkovac, une policière du Nebraska qui a servi comme gardienne de la paix dans la Bosnie d'après-guerre, dénonce l'ONU pour avoir dissimulé un scandale de trafic sexuel.

programme.title: Ma fille kidnappée!
programme.desc: Christy découvre que sa voisine est liée aux crimes sur lesquels enquêtait son père. Susan doit la sauver.

programme.title: L'amour au bout du chemin
programme.desc: Pour sauver son entreprise, Becca s'associe à Lee Price àla Barbade pour obtenir les droits et trouve l'amour.

programme.title: Piégée avec ma soeur
programme.desc: Une piscine va fermer pour un long week-end de vacances. Bree et sa sœur Joanna sont en difficulté.

programme.title: Qui a tué la petite JonBenet ?
programme.desc: Basé sur une affaire vraie, une reine de beauté de six ans est retrouvée morte dans la maison familiale.

programme.title: Gentleman menteur
programme.desc: Julie, veuve, est séduite par Martin, un arnaqueur pro qui s'immisce dans sa vie et celle de son fils.

programme.title: Un parfum de meurtre
programme.desc: En 1924, le magnat de la presse William Randolph Hearst invite certaines des personnalités les plus célèbres au monde pour une croisière sur son yacht, au cours de laquelle est commis un meurtre, à ce jour encore non élucidé et passé sous silence.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: Au cours de l'été 2001, Tyler (Robert Pattinson), étudiant à New York, est encore bouleversé suite à la tragédie qui a altéré la relation avec son père lorsqu'il rencontre Ally (Emilie de Ravin), une fille qui comprend sa douleur. C'est une histoire inoubliable sur le pouvoir de l'amour, la force de la famille et l'importance de chérir ceux qu'on aime chaque jour de sa vie.

programme.title: Ali
programme.desc: L'histoire de la vie du champion de boxe poids lourds, Muhammad Ali. Suivez les débuts du champion en tant que Cassius Clay, son ascension dans le sport et la politique, notamment son refus controversé de participer à la guerre du Vietnam ainsi que ses retours au combat notoires.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artiste de Los Angeles voit sa vie basculer lorsque son exposition d'art est annulée et que sa petite-amie mannequin le quitte.

programme.title: The Perfect Score
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson, Erika Christensen, Chris Evans et Darius Miles figurent dans cette histoire initiatique de six adolescents qui entrent par effraction dans le centre d'examens et volent les réponses des examens d'admission à l'université.

programme.title: Freedom Writers
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire de gamins durs à cuire élevés dans des milieux difficiles et la violence. Hilary Swank incarne une prof qui va leur donner la chose dont ils ont le plus besoin : une voix pour s'exprimer.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Giant Octopus
programme.desc: Les côtes californiennes deviennent le théâtre d'un surprenant mais non moins terrifiant spectacle : deux monstres marins, Mega Shark et Octopus, se battent en duel détruisant tout sur leur passage.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: L'histoire désopilante de l'accord parfait que passent Emma et Adam, basé entièrement sur le sexe et dont la seule règle est : Sex Friends.

programme.title: Voix ouf grand format
programme.desc: Voix ouf met en avant le monde du doublage et les artistes cachés derrière nos héros préférés.

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown

programme.title: Gillian Anderson On Not Being Ashamed Of Your Fantasies
programme.desc: Gillian Anderson joins Happy Place to discuss her new book 'Want', exploring the complexities of women's sexual fantasies and the importance of being open about them with ourselves and our partners. Gillian shares how her various roles from The X-Files to Sex Education have informed the person she is today. A 50-minute conversation about sex, confidence, and being a woman.

programme.title: David Tennant On The Struggles Throughout His Acting Career
programme.desc: David Tennant discusses the anxieties and stage fright he experiences as an actor, even with critical acclaim, and how a little fear can be useful to prevent complacency. He and Fearne explore how to work through moments when anxiety threatens to overwhelm you, and how concrete experiences over time provide a coping mechanism. David also shares his thoughts on whether celebrities should use their platform for social activism, and verifies some stories from online about his life.

programme.title: Dave Grohl On Overcoming Fear And Pursuing Your Dream
programme.desc: Foo Fighters and Nirvana drummer Dave Grohl discusses his new memoir The Storyteller, written during the pandemic. He talks with Fearne Cotton about the law of attraction, pursuing your dreams, and the importance of embracing mistakes and the unknown. Grohl reflects on his journey from hitting the road with Scream at 18 to his time in Nirvana and Foo Fighters, and how storytelling shaped his life from childhood in Springfield, Virginia.

programme.title: Chris McCausland: My Body Rests But My Brain Doesn't!
programme.desc: Comedian Chris McCausland chats with Fearne Cotton about holidays and travel. Chris explains how losing his sight has changed the way he approaches holidays, from planning activities and communicating in foreign countries to managing his dependence on loved ones. He discusses getting into his daughter's favourite holiday hobby: rollercoasters.

programme.title: Ant & Dec On Anxiety, Gratitude & Turning 50
programme.desc: In their first ever podcast appearance, Ant and Dec join Fearne and explain that nearly four decades into their careers they're still laughing together just as much as they did at the beginning, but now they've got far more gratitude for each day they get to be on TV.

programme.title: Caitlin Moran On How She Finally Calmed Her Nervous System
programme.desc: Writer Caitlin Moran discusses her 30-year battle with anxiety that began at age 13, and how she's now two years anxiety-free through choosing to be hopeful and see the good in life. She talks with Fearne Cotton about how social media has altered our perception of reality, the difference between posting angrily online and taking real-world action, social anxiety when meeting friends, and how presuming everyone's having a bad day can make you happier.

programme.title: Ashley Roberts On Coping With Anxiety And Insomnia
programme.desc: Ashley Roberts discusses her journey through burnout and body shaming during the height of the Pussycat Dolls' fame, and how discovering breathwork helped her recover from intense anxiety and physical ill-health. She talks about her mental health toolkit, the grief of losing her dad to suicide, and family mental illness. With Fearne Cotton, she shares experiences of insomnia and coping strategies.

programme.title: Adam Kay Opens Up About The PTSD That Made Him Leave The NHS
programme.desc: Former doctor Adam Kay discusses the traumatic day at work that left him with PTSD and led to his decision to leave the NHS. He explains how the experience affected his mental health, leaving him feeling paranoid and overcautious, and how he turned to diary writing to process his emotions. Adam and Fearne discuss mental health stigma in the workplace and at home, and offer advice for building mental health toolkits for crises of varying severity. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicide.

programme.title: Brian Cox's Guide To Being A True Scot
programme.desc: Brian Cox sets the record straight on what it really means to be Scottish. From authentic Scottish slang to the biggest misconceptions people, especially in America, still get wrong. With sharp wit and no-nonsense honesty, he dives into real Scottish slang and what it actually means, the stereotypes that need binning immediately, the cultural differences that confuse the rest of the world, and a cheeky look at some of America's more baffling takes on Scotland.

programme.title: Big Tech Is Destroying Democracy
programme.desc: Baroness Beeban Kidron, filmmaker and tech campaigner, discusses her book Users: How Big Tech Took Control and How to Fight Back. She breaks down how big tech companies have influenced democracy, warped regulatory structures for their own benefit, and knowingly harmed their users.

programme.title: When Did Elon Musk Lose His Mind?
programme.desc: When did Elon Musk make the jump from salesman to supervillain? Quinn Slobodian and Ben Tarnoff trace Musk's journey from tech billionaire to stalwart of the online right. From his upbringing in apartheid South Africa to the rise of Tesla and SpaceX, they detail his changing views on AI and the "woke mind virus", as well as his eventual alliance with Donald Trump. Slobodian and Tarnoff examine his industrial philosophy, what led him to the White House, his purchase of Twitter, and his various attempts to further fuse technology into our lives.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Keir Starmer's Weirdest Moments As Prime Minister
programme.desc: Keir Starmer's time in office has come to a close. His legacy includes some strange moments. From meeps to releasing sausages to going footy mad, relive all of the best and worst moments from the last two years. Hear clashes with Rishi Sunak and Kemi Badenoch, awkward encounters with Donald Trump, and gaffes at various major summits.

programme.title: AI CEOs Being Absolutely Insane
programme.desc: Have you ever paid attention to the voices behind the 'inevitable' AI revolution? OpenAI's Sam Altman, SpaceX's Elon Musk, and Palantir's Alex Karp are among the tech elite. They're building the models they claim will change work, politics, and life forever. But when they talk about this future, their rhetoric ranges from bizarre to sinister. From Musk's prediction that there's "a 10 to 20% chance of killer robots wiping out humanity" to Altman's sale of intelligence as utility, things look pretty bleak.

programme.title: Donald Trump's Most Embarrassing Moments
programme.desc: Donald Trump has a lot to say about the world. That doesn't mean he knows what he's talking about. From China to Venezuela and Canada to the UK, watch Trump's questionable comments about all corners of the globe.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.desc: 10 people go head to head in a movie quiz to see who will be the last one standing. If they get one question wrong they have to sit. programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: Hugh Jackman Takes On The Irish Test

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The Wismar Bay is unique in its diversity on the Mecklenburg Baltic Sea coast: cliffs, sandy beaches, salt marshes, enchanted islands and, last but not least, the proud Hanseatic city of Wismar with its brick Gothic buildings, which are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. When the mighty logs get wedged together in the timber mill in the port of Wismar, Steven Buchholz has to get to work with his chainsaw. It's a dangerous job, because the logs weigh tons. As a trained carpenter, Steven is a virtuoso with the chain saw. Even after his shift is over, he is looking for the thrill: the wind off his home island of Poel is favorable that day and he wants to reclaim the German record in the kite surfing high jump. For a long time, Ramona Stelzer only knew fish as a tasty ingredient between two halves of a bun. But when the goldsmith got her hands on fish leather, her business idea was born: she processes the unique natural product fish skin into fine jewelry. The problem is that hardly anyone in Germany tans fish skin. In order to reliably obtain supplies, Ramona now wants to learn this craft herself.

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Bavaria's Alpine Kingdom
programme.desc: There are sparkling palaces from ice and snow, like those found in a fairytale. The icy castles are the phenomenal work of Mother Nature but man had a hand in the magnificent stone castles of the region. The spectacular and histrionic mountains of the Bavarian Alps challenge wildlife and the people who live there and the rocky ramparts of this mountain kingdom are built of limestone and fossil rocks that tell of its origins beneath the sea. Millions of visitors from all over the world come to Bavaria every year to witness the mysticism of the landscape. Kings and Queens, tourist and locals, all are welcomed in the fantastic alpine kingdom. Early summer often comes with the threat of storms that bring floods that scour the land and threaten many creatures. But farmers risk these dangers to take their herds to the highest pastures, where they can graze on the sweetest flower-filled meadows. And later from the high-quality milk produced by their herds, the famers make highly prized cheese. Humankind lives among eagle owls, chamoix, wild cats, stoats and ravens up in these mountains.

When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables his garden has never grown so much produce! programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Girls on Mission
programme.desc: Things are getting mixed up on Andrea's first day on the job at Heartlake City Juicebar. Andrea relaxes at the beach while Emma is hard at work at her lifeguard tower. Emma and Stephanie accidentally rent a scary movie and suddenly there are beasts everywhere... Olivia tapes a science show, with a little help from Mia's lemonade stand - and special effects! Mia and Stephanie have to use a little horse power at the Sunshine Ranch. Stephanie has to face her fears when the class gets an 'Animal Kingdom & 'school assignment.'

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band Silica Gel! Known for their iconic explosive energy this quartet impressed both listeners and critics with their self-titled debut album Silica Gel in 2016. Not surprisingly they swept various major rookie awards that year and quickly became new leaders of the Korean indie music scene. Back in December 2017 after the release of the EP SiO2.nH2O Silica Gel took a hiatus to complete their mendatory military duties and then returned in August this year with the much-anticipated new single KYO181. In this episode Silica Gel performs KYO181 NEO SOUL Nap and more to showcase their unchaning unpredictable energy and sound just like their name. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and take a glimpse into their experimental yet genuine musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the multi-talented musician Ahn Ye-eun! This artist made herself known to the public in 2015 as the runner-up of the audition program K-Pop Star Season 5. During the show she amazed the public with her songwriting skills including Red Tie which she wrote after watching the film The King and the Clown. 2 years later Red Tie was featured in the soundtrack of the TV series The Rebel along with another one of her compositions Magic Lily. This past August she released her third single Trumpet Creeper which is about a court lady once loved by the king but forgotten soon. With her trademark heartrending voice she presents a beautiful harmony of pop and traditional sounds. In this episode Ahn Ye-eun performs Red Tie Trumpet Creeper KAKOTOPIA Goblin and more to showcase the quintessence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy her unique music!

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.
